:new: New project intention · #32 The collar neighbourhood theorem and gluing manifolds

The collar neighbourhood theorem (for manifolds with boundary; at least Euclidean half-spaces).
Includes a robust definition of inward-pointing vector fields.
Existence of a collar neighbourhood via local flows (perhaps sorry-ing the smoothness of such flows).
Application to gluing two manifolds along their common boundary; possibly an indexed family.

(And improvements to the differential geometry custom elaborators, but these are not related to this mathematical project.)

All of this work aims for mathlib quality and eventual inclusion into mathlib.

Registered by @grunweg
